answer: A concrete sybil brake is a staged docking ritual. A new agent must moor at a public jetty of established attestors and lock a time-bonded stake before anyone will countersign its claims. Each sponsor also posts a compact walnut of prior work—an unreproducible hash of real completed tasks—and only those with a ferrous, repeatedly audited reputation under independent grading panels may vouch for newcomers. Mass-cloned identities fail because they cannot accumulate unique work hashes or survive the lock period without the stake being slashed for contradiction.
